## View Paper

**[Early Detection of Osteoarthritis Stage by Applying Classification Techniques to Human joint Imagery](http://kb.psu.ac.th:8080/psukb/bitstream/2016/13400/1/435044.pdf)** (PDF)

## Publication

**Author:** Sophal Chan  
**Degree:** M.S. Information Technology, College of Computing, Prince of Songkla University, Phuket

## Background of the Study

Integrates three representation families—**texture**, **graph**, and **CNN**—for knee OA detection and staging on X-ray imagery.

## Motivation of the Study

Identify which representation + classifier pipeline is most defensible for clinical screening and thesis contribution.

## Key Results

| Approach | OA detection AUC | Stage classification AUC |
|----------|------------------|---------------------------|
| Texture-based | **0.912** | **0.871** |
| Graph-based | 0.917 | 0.819 |
| CNN | 0.880 | 0.629 |
